label: access sheet step 1
from: 1. Staff (Manager, Finance, Teacher, Security): tap Share, enter their email and set them as Editor. Without this they can't see any records.
to: 1. Staff create an account on the sign-in page and tap the access they need. They then appear below under Waiting.

label: access sheet step 2
from: 2. When they open the link they pick the access they need and appear below under Waiting. Tap Approve or choose another role.
to: 2. Tap Approve, or choose another role from the list. Until you do, they can see nothing.

until: outside editors out of the records.
to:

  1. Ask them to open the system's web address and tap Create account.
  2. They tap the access they need on the waiting screen.
  3. Tap Manage who can use the system above and approve them.

To remove someone, set their role to No access in that list.
